title: The frontend repeats the declaration date immediately under the confirmation panel; DR1 shows it only on the declaration page and never again.

finding.frontend: Directly below the green confirmation panel the page prints 'Date of declaration:' followed by the submission date at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/template.njk:11, with its label at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/copy/copy.en.js:7. It is the first thing under the reference number, ahead of anything telling the user what happens next.
finding.prototype: DR1's submitted page goes from the reference panel straight into what the user has to do — the outstanding items where there are any, then 'Transporting the consignment' (app/views/notification-submitted.html:20-48). The declaration date appears once in the journey, on the declaration page itself, and is not repeated here.
finding.difference: Remove the date-of-declaration line and its copy entry from the confirmation page in both languages. It is the only content on the frontend's confirmation page that DR1 does not have, and it occupies the position DR1 gives to what the user must do next.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a date-of-declaration line on DR1's submitted page.
finding.correction:
The finding is right and the slot stands, but one sentence in `difference` is overstated. Verified: the frontend prints 'Date of declaration: 19 August 2026' as the first thing under the green panel (template.njk:11), and the string 'Date of declaration' appears nowhere in app/views/notification-submitted.html or in the DR1 capture — DR1 goes panel, then 'Before the consignment is imported' where there is anything outstanding, then 'Transporting the consignment'. Both screenshots confirm. What is overstated is 'It is the only content on the frontend's confirmation page that DR1 does not have'. It is not: the frontend's view-or-amend body reads 'You can view or amend this notification from your dashboard and resubmit it.' against DR1's 'You can view or change this notification from your dashboard.' (that difference is an amend artefact and rightly excluded), and the frontend's 'contact HMRC' link points at a different gov.uk page from DR1's. Read the sentence as 'the only content of DR1's own on this page that the frontend adds', which is what it means and what is true. THE NAMED CONTROL IS ON THE PAGE BUT CANNOT BE CROPPED, AND IS KEPT NAMED. 'Date of declaration:' is not missing from the corpus — fe-confirmation.html:116 holds `

Date of declaration: 20 August 2026

`, exactly where the finding says it is. It resolves to nothing because the line is a bare paragraph: it is not a form control, a link, a heading, a summary row or a tag, so the only rung that could reach it is the last one, which is exact-match only, and the paragraph's text is the label plus that day's date. Naming the full string would pin the control to a date that changes every capture, which the finding contract rules out for exactly this reason. So there is no element crop and there will not be one; the evidence for this finding is the whole-page shot of fe-confirmation, where the line sits immediately under the green panel and above everything telling the user what happens next, which is the position the finding is about. On the DR1 side the absence is the finding: the string occurs nowhere in dr1-notification-submitted.html.

relatedTo.why: both are about what sits between the panel and the transport guidance
